title: Ezekiel 37:1-11 | Excerpt from "The 4 Temples of Jerusalem"

sense.text:
The hand of the Lord was upon Ezekiel and carried him out in the spirit of the Lord, and set him down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones. The Lord put Ezekiel in the valley, and he looked down, and the valley is filled with bones.

The Lord caused him to pass by them round about, and there were very many in the open valley, and “lo, they were very dry.” Them bones was dry.
Sinews laid upon them, flesh brought up upon them, and “cover you with skin, and put breath in you.” The skin deals with identity: they are going to get some kind of identity.

The bones came together and the sinews and the flesh came up upon them and the skin covered them above, “but there was no breath in them.” They came together as Christians, they came together as Muslims, and there was no breath in them. No breath at all, none whatsoever. So they tried to get some kind of identity.

Look at our people coming together: some of them Muslim, some of them Christians, and that causes disunity. Christianity and Islam are two of the bloodiest religions that destroyed our race, destroyed our people — that's right, Islam too. And they all made their little heart; all of them got the image of Jesus in their heart. That is not what God is talking about. That is what it means, and there was no breath in them.

What does that breath mean? The words of God was not in them. There is no breath, no life in Islam. No breath, no life in Christianity. No breath, no life in any of these man-made religions. There is no breath, there is no life there.

And when it talks about life, it is about eternal life — rulership, reigning on the earth. All people in these religions are not going to get it. However many Hail Mary laws and however many Hail Marys they do, it means nothing to the one true God, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

Ezekiel prophesied as he was commanded, “and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.” The breath that came into them is the word of God; the words of Christ came into them.

An exceeding great army. That is what John saw, and that is what Ezekiel saw.

“Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel.” All twelve tribes. If you were confused about the valley of dry bones, verse 11 explains who they are.

And this is what they say of themselves: “Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.”

precepts.why:
“The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.” That's it, because they have no understanding. The bones that came together with no breath in them remain in the congregation of the dead.

You following white supremacy, you call it Christianity. Another group is following the Arabs, you call it Islam. And both of them destroyed us mentally and physically.

What that breath is: “It is the spirit that quickeneth; the flesh profiteth nothing: the words that I speak unto you, they are spirit, and they are life.” Quickeneth means changes, converts.

The flesh profiteth nothing. It is the words that are spirit and they are life, and the words of God was not in them.
“Keep my commandments, and live.” What gives us life is keeping the commandments.

“This is the book of the commandments of God, and the law that endureth for ever: all they that keep it shall come to life; but such as leave it shall die.”

All that keep it shall come to life, but such as leave it shall die. So now we have understanding of what that breath is talking about: the commandments.

“And after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet” — after 350 years. That is the same thing Ezekiel was talking about: the Holy Spirit entered into us, and we stood upon our feet as the Israelites, the twelve tribes.

“And great fear fell upon them which saw them.” The nations that live around us are afraid, and they are very afraid. The ones that know the history are afraid of this awakening, because they know what that means: Messiah is soon to come. They get their timing from the awakening of the twelve tribes. They observe and watch.

They ain't worried about you on the street with your pants below your butt. They ain't worried about you teaching the Bible talking about we going to rape white women — that's not them. But the brothers that's out teaching identity and the commandments, that's the group they worried about. That group right there, the ones hitting over this country and that country, this side of the world and that side of the world, they're the problem. Purple and gold is a problem.

All the rest of them little Israelite camps that change their doctrine from today to tomorrow, one group playing with each other's booty hole, another group talking about don't listen to James, don't listen to Paul — they worried about those groups, they're not worried about them. We ain't saying we ain't got idiots among us; we do, we know. But the vast majority of us is going to ride.

The same thing that the Apostle Paul was saying: “That at that time ye were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise.” Cut off for our parts is being without Christ, aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, strangers from the covenants of promise.

“Having no hope.” Didn't we just read it? Our hope is lost — that is what it said in Ezekiel 37:11. Paul says the same thing Ezekiel said. “And without God in the world.”

Read on: “But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ.” Christ has come, and the blood of Christ brings us back together. “For he is our peace, who hath made both one” — both kingdoms, the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, one nation. “And hath broken down the middle wall of partition between us.” So what was between us? The animal sacrifice. Christ did away with that.

sense.text:
We are not physically dead, but we are spiritually dead. That is what it is talking about. Our dead bodies are our spiritually dead bodies lying “in the street of the great city.” The great city is Babylon the Great, which is aka the United States of America.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom.” It is not the real Sodom, but America is a spiritual Sodom, because they got same-sex relations here, and it is glorified.

And it ain't real Egypt, but it is a spiritual Egypt, because just like all twelve tribes was captive in ancient Egypt and learned hundreds of different gods, so are we here in America, captive learning hundreds of different gods. Nike is a god. Adidas is a god. Gucci, Fendi — those are family names, and they have set themselves up as gods. Some of you will kill each other over a Fendi, over a Gucci. Damn. And just like in ancient Egypt, pull out a dollar bill: you got the pyramid and the all-seeing eye on the back of the $1 bill. You think they put that there by accident? They know that this is a spiritual Egypt. It is our people in Christianity who have not figured that out yet.

“Where also our Lord was crucified.” Our Lord crucified — that is Jerusalem. This ain't the real Jerusalem, but it is a spiritual Jerusalem. What did they do in ancient Jerusalem? They betrayed the son of God and rejected his teachings. What's here in America? They reject the son of God, they betrayed the son of God and reject his teachings. It's the same spirit. That same evil negro spirit back then, them that were the betrayers of Christ, is here today, and that spirit is just flowing. Some of them sitting in here just waiting for an opportune time. Mark my words.

“And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half” — 350 years. “And shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves”, because they are not physically dead, they are spiritually dead.

“And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry, and shall send gifts one to another.” They made a holiday over our destruction. Merry Christmas. We were the gifts.

A lot of you don't realize that Christmas is a day of our destruction. You won't find that out unless you live in the Netherlands or Amsterdam, where they tell you the real deal with that holiday: Pope Nicholas V and Swarte Piet. Pope Nicholas V is the one that set up the transatlantic slave trade and enslaved all the black Jews that they call Moors. That's what Christmas is about.

“Because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth” — to torment this white man, when we ruled.

precepts.why:
“And other ten thousand left alive did the children of Judah carry away captive, and brought them unto the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, that they all were broken in pieces.” That's torment.

And from verse 11: “And Amaziah strengthened himself, and led forth his people, and went to the valley of salt, and smote of the children of Seir ten thousand.” Ten thousand smitten in the valley of salt, and the other ten thousand carried away captive and cast down from the top of the rock. That's what we did. That's the history, and they know the history — the European whites, their elites, they know.

You be on the street talking about, I don't know why they — what did we do? We didn't do anything. Are you serious? Read a book. These people was evil and we treated them evil. These were a vile race, a vile group; Isaiah 14 calls them the seed of evildoers. So we treated them the way they deserved to be treated. Pushed that whole group off the cliff, because God said to do it.

Then we broke the commandments and the white man said, oh, we got you now. Now here we are in captivity, and they ain't letting their foot off our neck, and they're never going to tell us the true history of what the Bible says. Oh yeah, Jesus loves the little children, everybody loves Jesus — white Jesus. And everybody go, yeah, you Israelites is the devil, y'all is all wrong. No, we're telling you the history. You just don't want to hear it.

sense.text:
“And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.” One nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel, one king over them all, and never again two kingdoms.

That is the same thing Paul said in Ephesians 2, verse 14. He got that from Ezekiel.

precepts.why:
“For he is our peace, who hath made both one.” That is what he is talking about: both kingdoms, the kingdom of Judah and the kingdom of Israel, one nation.

Paul got that from Ezekiel — one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel, no more two nations, neither divided into two kingdoms any more at all.
